caption: This miso ramen boasts a rich, golden broth, topped with tender chashu pork, crisp nori, and chopped green onions. Served in a patterned bowl with a white spoon, it rests on a dark tray under warm, inviting light.

segments_info.text: Black tray with orange rim, smooth surface, rectangular shape, slightly reflective, edges visible.
Chashu pork: tender, slightly fatty slice with golden-brown sear, irregular shape, and visible marbling on surface.
Nori seaweed: dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, with visible surface ridges and slight curling edges.
The miso broth is golden-yellow, glossy, and rich, with visible noodles and toppings floating on its surface.
The bowl is white ceramic with a glossy orange rim featuring a repeating geometric pattern.
A white plastic spoon with smooth, curved surface and slightly tapered end, showing subtle gloss and faint yellow stain near handle.
